name: Toshokan Ressha
source:
Lonely boys and girls spend their lives aimlessly as they have nowhere to go. A strange woman called a librarian invites them to the urban air pocket "library train."

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
孤独的男孩和女孩无处可去，只能漫无目的地生活。一名名叫图书管理员的奇怪女人邀请他们前往都市空洞“图书馆列车”。

[来自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-august-2006-eve-new.html]vndbreview[/url]]
